Downloaded: 2026-11-21.
Local changes: none. Built by build_bench.py --benchmark rt for rv64imb (lp64,
  soft float) only, with -std=c11 -D__SOFTFP__ (compiler-rt's integer-only paths,
  as for soft-float Arm targets); fp_mode.c is the generic version (round to
  nearest, no exception flags). The rv64imfd build links none of them.

  __gtsf2 __gesf2 __adddf3 __subdf3 __muldf3 __divdf3 __eqdf2 __nedf2 __ltdf2
  __gtdf2 __gedf2 __extendsfdf2 __fixdfdi __floatsidf __floatunsidf __floatdidf
  __floatundidf (and their helpers).
